title: Why Japanese People BOW Instead of Shaking Hands
description: No handshakes, no hugs, just a clean bow. But the angle of your bow actually says A LOT. What's the greeting style in YOUR culture? Let me know!

sections.narration: Imagine you meet someone in Japan and reach out for a handshake like normal.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy extending hand forward, Japanese street background, warm

sections.narration: But instead of grabbing your hand, they bow, and now you're just standing there awkwardly.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy with hand out, other person bowing, warm city scene

sections.narration: You try to bow back but you have no idea how low to go.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy doing uncertain half-bow, question marks above, warm tones

sections.narration: So basically, bowing in Japan isn't just saying hello — it's a whole language.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy demonstrating three different bow angles, warm background

sections.narration: A small fifteen-degree nod is casual, like saying 'hey' to a friend.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy doing slight nod, friend waving, casual warm setting

sections.narration: And it gets weirder — a full forty-five degree bow means deep gratitude or apology.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy in deep bow, angle measurement shown, warm office scene

sections.narration: But here's the thing — bowing is actually more hygienic than shaking hands.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy bowing cleanly, sparkle effect on hands, warm background

sections.narration: You show respect without any physical contact, which is pretty genius honestly.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy and another person bowing with space between, warm tones

sections.narration: So THAT'S why bowing stuck around — it communicates respect, status, and feeling all at once.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy with lightbulb, three bow levels illustrated, warm scene

sections.narration: One simple movement says more than a handshake ever could.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy doing perfect bow, cherry blossom petals, warm pink tones

sections.narration: Next time someone bows to you, just match their angle and you're golden.
sections.visual_notes: Centered: boy and friend bowing equally, smiling, warm Japanese garden
Centered: boy giving thumbs up, warm earth-toned background, simple
